examples.title: Example 1: Configuring a Simple Tree View
examples.description: This example showcases how to use TreeController to perform operations on tree nodes, such as adding, deleting, and renaming. It also demonstrates the effects of adding nodes with different parameters.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Symbol Icon
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use symbolIconStyle, symbolEditIconStyle, and symbolSelectedIconStyle in NodeParam to set custom symbol icons. This functionality is supported since API version 18.
